N2_AUTO_APPROVAL_BYPASS_PATCH_REPORT.head: 1d9ac067
controls_added: StrictOperatorAccess dependency on 4 critical mutating endpoints
Blocks non-local unauthorized access (requires BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN env var + X-Brain-Token header)
No local-address bypass for these endpoints (StrictOperatorAccess disallows localhost)
payload_trust_removed: payload.by is no longer sufficient to bypass approval because StrictOperatorAccess is required before proposal apply/reject execution.
audit_only no longer allows auto-apply without StrictOperatorAccess (identity verified by dependency, not body)
remaining_risks: StrictOperatorAccess requires BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN env var. If not configured, all StrictOperatorAccess endpoints return 403.
If BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN is leaked, all StrictOperatorAccess endpoints are compromised.
No HMAC/signature per-request anti-replay. Token is reusable.
No audit log written to disk for every approved/rejected action. Only in-memory gate state.
POST /tool01/permission/approve still only uses session lookup (not StrictOperatorAccess).
N2_AUTO_APPROVAL_BYPASS_PATCH_REPORT.recommendation: ACCEPTED (pending ledger update and runtime smoke)
N2_AUTO_APPROVAL_BYPASS_PATCH_REPORT.next_step: Create ledger checkpoint N2, run runtime smoke on Brain V9 to confirm StrictOperatorAccess endpoints return 403 without token, then commit/push upon authorization.
